title: Best Marriott Bonvoy hotels in Singapore
intro: Singapore is a compact but dense Marriott Bonvoy market for EliteStay -- {{count}} hotels concentrated around Marina Bay, Orchard Road and the CBD, from The Ritz-Carlton, Millenia Singapore and The Singapore EDITION down to Courtyard and Four Points' business-friendly stays.
editorial_notes: Hand-drafted 2026-08-17 to seed the restored Best Of feature (see commit that reversed 4e2fc60). Hotel count verified against data/entities at draft time -- re-check if the catalogue grows materially before this is regenerated.

faqs.question: How many Marriott Bonvoy hotels are there in Singapore?
faqs.answer: EliteStay tracks {{count}} Marriott Bonvoy hotels in Singapore, spanning luxury properties like The Ritz-Carlton, Millenia Singapore, The Singapore EDITION and The St. Regis Singapore through to Autograph Collection, JW Marriott and Courtyard-branded stays across the city.

faqs.question: How is this list ranked?
faqs.answer: Hotels are ordered by guest sentiment -- the same 0-100 read of public guest reviews shown on every hotel's own page. It grades a property against its own class rather than against luxury hotels, so the ranking updates automatically as research on individual properties is refreshed.
